features.title: Persist and replay ordered memory events
features.summary: Append events to isolated streams, replay in order, deduplicate re-ingested events, and serialize concurrent writers without gaps.
failureModes: Positions remain contiguous under interleaved concurrent writers.
Database files are private to the user and migrations are idempotent.

verification.testName: appends, replays in order and ignores re-ingested events
serializes writers from concurrent threads without gaps or duplicate positions
creates the database private to the user and migrates idempotently

features.title: Search and zoom within authorized memory scope
features.summary: Search exact terms and snippets across conversations in the same project, keep other projects hidden, and return bounded zoomable context.
failureModes: Cross-project results remain denied unless explicitly enabled.
Secrets are redacted before event, tree, or index persistence.

verification.testName: shares a project across conversations but hides other projects
searches all projects only when allowed
redacts secrets before they reach the events, the tree or the index

features.title: Build and persist incremental memory summaries
features.summary: Create complete hierarchy nodes, preserve summaries byte-for-byte across reload, extend at the tail, and report raw pending items explicitly.
failureModes: A pending leaf is rendered as raw and tagged rather than omitted.
New histories produce deterministic summaries and view bytes.

externalDependencies.deterministicFake: Inject a gated synthetic summarizer with success, timeout, failure, cancellation, and concurrency cases; no paid model calls.

verification.testName: is deterministic for the same history
reloads the persisted view byte-for-byte instead of rebuilding it
renders leaves still waiting for a summary raw and tagged instead of omitting them
times out a hung summarizer and frees its concurrency slot

features.title: Recover interrupted indexing and migrate persisted views
features.summary: Complete interrupted pipelines when reopened, retain main and secondary views across schema migration, and explicitly bound pending tails.
failureModes: A summarizer failure retains source history for later retry.
Version-1 views migrate without rebuilding away stored content.

verification.testName: finishes an interrupted pipeline when a new engine opens the same database
never loses history when the summarizer fails, and retries on the next append
migrates a version-1 database by keeping its views as the main kind
